sources.title: 🌐 MRL 世界模型頂層規則修訂暨命名治理 v1.1 — 雙容器／全域容納／粒子轉譯／自動拓撲

rules.definition_authority: Notion MRL world model and its referenced governance pages; local projection is derived only
rules.provenance: Preserve original names, attribution, source lineage and External-to-MRL mappings. No competing mother line.
rules.commercial_roles: Suppliers, AI workers and hosting/storage providers do not automatically acquire product authority.
rules.rights: Name and separate access/use/deployment/modification/derivative/distribution/sublicense/data/source/core/brand/commercialization rights; unspecified rights NOT_GRANTED / UNRESOLVED.
rules.commercial_gate: Creator, product authority, retained core rights, third-party licenses, customer data rights and termination export must be clear before COMMERCIAL_APPROVED; this review adapter cannot approve transactions.
rules.conflicts: Record conflicts for review; do not overwrite Notion definitions with generated findings.
rules.legal_effect: Internal governance baseline; third-party terms, signed contracts and applicable law remain distinct per constitution section 11.
rules.evidence: Definition, code, deployment, payment and customer acceptance are separate evidence states.
